coder_notes: Multi-tumour basket (ovary, breast, thyroid, H&N, gastric, NSCLC, mesothelioma, oesophageal, endometrial, cervical, melanoma, colorectal, grade 4 glioma) plus DIPG/DMG cohort. Glioblastoma is not in the conditions; coded basket_gbm_eligible because grade 4 glioma (IDH wild-type and IDH-mutant) is a listed tumour type and glioblastoma is named in the DIPG/DMG inclusion criterion (b). IDH-mutant tumours are allowed so cns5_terminology is historical. DFMO is given as IV continuous infusion (route flagged new_route; the registry does not say what the standard route is). H3 K27M appears in the conditions but is not an entry requirement. Blood polyamine uptake PD; PK stated as plasma.
